status: Shared PD read helper classified; power-descriptor arithmetic separated from private vendor-control gate

reader_code.mapping: Common lower32KiB plus full-image upper window at18000hex, selector3; CPU upper address maps to full offset CPU+10000hex. Live flash match unverified.

shared_helper.sets: R3=1, R2=A, R5=98hex, R7=4. Caller has already prepared the selector, receive length and buffers.
shared_helper.meaning: Common one-selector read preparation, not itself a private USB4-entry command.

reviewed_direct_callers.purpose: Already recovered UCSI CCI4 plus MESSAGE_IN16; duplicate relay path, not new mode policy.
Private status byte mapped into a local cached status slot; physical port numbering and bit meanings unqualified.
Four-byte power-descriptor-shaped value parsed by type/voltage/current fields below.

reader_code.other_shared_wrapper: A separate equivalent wrapper at be4e calls the same1ff4 transport; reviewed status processing also reads selectorb0. No live request was issued.

cc_parser.entry_gate: Cached status slotB bits7 and6 set, bit3 clear; semantic names unqualified.
cc_parser.type_field: Top two bits of first returned byte; type3 takes the clear-output branch, while0/1/2 use separate arithmetic paths.
cc_parser.fixed_type0_voltage: Combine low nibble of byte1 and upper6 bits of byte2, shift right2, multiply by50.
cc_parser.fixed_type0_current: Combine low2 bits of byte2 and byte3, multiply by10.
cc_parser.byte_order_convention: byte0 is the first returned byte; the field layout corresponds to a big-endian32-bit PDO interpretation.
cc_parser.scope: Static arithmetic and branch facts. No measured CC reply, negotiated contract, live flag/cache value or timing is available.

reader_code.return_handling: For each reviewed transfer, R7=0 skips processing of that reply. A failed b1 read leaves the previous cached status in place, and the later CC-read gate can still consult that cache. No capture establishes that such a failure or stale value occurred. Nonzero remains firmware transport status, not independent physical validation.
reader_code.direct_caller_scan_limit: Three literal LCALL c720 sites in this bank view were decoded at their instruction boundaries. This does not exclude indirect calls or other bank entry paths.

pdo_reference.title: Upstream Linux USB Power Delivery definitions
pdo_reference.definitions: PDO type occupies bits31:30. Fixed voltage uses bits19:10 in50mV units; fixed current uses bits9:0 in10mA units.
pdo_reference.interpretation: The retained EC type0 masks, shifts and multipliers match this power-descriptor layout. This supports classification as power reporting rather than a direct USB4 link-status observation.
pdo_reference.limit: Reference correspondence, not a vendor register specification or proof that any particular reply/contract existed on ASUS. No Linux control was ported to Windows.

request_gate.request_81_condition: Firmware flag03c7.bit1 clear AND0308.bit6 set; otherwise request80. These flags have no established board/USB4 meaning here.

pair_81.prepared_fields: Address-byte98, commandd8/data81, then commandd9/data81 via common355f.
pair_81.latch_update: Set030e.bit0 only after both wrapper calls return nonzero.

pair_80.prepared_fields: Address-byte98, commandd8/data80, then commandd9/data80 via common355f.
pair_80.latch_update: Clear030e.bit0 only after both wrapper calls return nonzero.

vendor_controls.transport_path: Common355f loads targete541 and enters3000, which selects bank1. Bank1e541 calls ef91 to marshal the prepared fields, sets R5=88hex/R7=4, then calls common1809. This is a distinct wrapper from raw1ff4 reads; its physical command semantics are not inferred from the literal values.
vendor_controls.outer_gate: Common1809 also tests030e.bit1 for the reviewed channel4/non-exempt-address path. This outer service block bit1 is distinct from the private pair latch bit0 in the same byte.
vendor_controls.upstream_anchor: Common33d9 selects bank3 targetb8cd through3028. A literal call at bank1b9ff is a next caller anchor; no power-state meaning assigned yet.
vendor_controls.scope: Preparation, dispatch and success bookkeeping are code facts. No live latch value, controller acceptance, retimer effect, safe inverse or Windows intervention has been established.

lookup_scope.scope: The inspected ITE-authored DisplayPort-support patch coordinates OS mux/retimer state from UCSI connector/CAM data. It does not define the meaning of these ASUS D8/D9 operations or implement a demonstrated ASUS USB4 repair. Different platform/code path.
lookup_scope.search_limit: Exact IT8853 D8/81 queries produced no usable register definition in this bounded lookup; absence from search is not absence of documentation.

decision.shared_c720: Close as a standalone USB4-entry lead: it is common read setup, including the already traced UCSI reply path.
decision.cc_power_parser: Retain as a separate power-reporting path; do not label its cached outputs or type3 branch as an observed USB4 failure.
decision.d8_d9: Keep exact gate/transport/latch code, but do not execute or assign mux/reset/USB4 semantics without ownership and side-effect evidence.
decision.next_task: Trace bank1b9ff/common33d9 caller context and setters of03c7.bit1/0308.bit6 to determine what chooses the D8/D9 request. Follow only proven bank-correct edges; do not build another flag reader or speculate from values80/81.

analysis_quality.source_classes: Original code facts, reference correspondence and live unknowns separated.
analysis_quality.preserved_attempts: Broad ranges may begin/end mid-instruction; only exact entry/call boundaries and span assertions are used. One initial helper view used the current bank3 window; common3000 proves the target is bank1 and the corrected bank1 view is authoritative. A metadata-only Python print had an unmatched parenthesis and was corrected; originals remain unchanged.
